import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
screen=Path('/private/tmp/fq-two-qubit-operand-order-20261122/docs/development/evidence/compiler-operand-order-screen.json')
stage=Path('/private/tmp/fq-two-qubit-operand-order-20261122/docs/development/evidence/compiler-application-stage-replay.json')
p=json.loads(screen.read_text());s=json.loads(stage.read_text());assert p['completed']
bundle=Bundle(Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/docs/implementation'))
seen=set();count=0;maximum=0.0
for row in p['rows']:
 key=(row['case'],row['workflow'],row['seed']);assert key not in seen;seen.add(key)
 n,family,topology=row['case'].split('/');n=int(n)
 f=fixture(n,family,topology,p['manifest']['input_nonce'])
 metrics=routing(row['payload'],f,None,bundle.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if n==8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{n:02d}'],0)
 assert metrics==row['metrics'] and row['status']=='accepted';count+=1;maximum=max(maximum,metrics['max_semantic_error'])
assert count==120
stages=0
for case in s['cases']:
 n,family,topology=case['case'].split('/');n=int(n);f=fixture(n,family,topology,p['manifest']['input_nonce'])
 for row in case['stages']:
  if 'acceptance' not in row:continue
  payload={'operations':row['native_operations'],'final_layout':list(range(n)),'compile_wall_seconds':0}
  metrics=routing(payload,f,None,bundle.cases[f'ROUTE-LINE-{n:02d}'],0)
  assert metrics==row['acceptance'];stages+=1;maximum=max(maximum,metrics['max_semantic_error'])
assert not {'flagquantum','qiskit','cirq'}.intersection(sys.modules)
proof={'evidence_class':'development','source_commit':p['source_commit'],'screen_sha256':hashlib.sha256(screen.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'stage_sha256':hashlib.sha256(stage.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'candidate_rows_replayed':count,'routed_stage_rows_replayed':stages,'producer_sdks_imported':False,'max_semantic_error':maximum,'script_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
Path('/private/tmp/fq-two-qubit-operand-order-20261122/docs/development/evidence/compiler-operand-order-replay.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in proof.items() if k!='script_source'}))

import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/private/tmp/fq-two-qubit-operand-order-20261122');folder=root/'docs/development/evidence'
screen=folder/'compiler-operand-order-screen.json';original=screen.read_bytes();index=json.loads(original);rows=index['rows'];index['rows']=[];files=[]
for family in ('qaoa','ising','hopping','qft','repetition'):
 selected=[{'position':i,'row':row} for i,row in enumerate(rows) if row['case'].split('/')[1]==family]
 path=folder/f'compiler-operand-order-{family}.json';data=(json.dumps(selected,separators=(',',':'))+'\n').encode();assert len(data)<1800000;path.write_bytes(data)
 files.append({'path':path.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'row_count':len(selected)})
index['row_files']=files;index['original_observation_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest();screen.write_text(json.dumps(index,indent=2)+'\n')
reconstructed={k:v for k,v in index.items() if k not in ('row_files','original_observation_sha256')};positions=[]
for item in files:
 data=(folder/item['path']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==item['sha256'];positions.extend(json.loads(data))
assert sorted(item['position'] for item in positions)==list(range(120));reconstructed['rows']=[v['row'] for v in sorted(positions,key=lambda x:x['position'])]
assert hashlib.sha256((json.dumps(reconstructed,indent=2)+'\n').encode()).hexdigest()==index['original_observation_sha256']
stage=folder/'compiler-application-stage-replay.json';stage_raw=stage.read_bytes();stage.write_text(json.dumps(json.loads(stage_raw),separators=(',',':'))+'\n');assert (json.dumps(json.loads(stage.read_bytes()),indent=2)+'\n').encode()==stage_raw
proof=folder/'compiler-operand-order-replay.json';p=json.loads(proof.read_text());assert p['screen_sha256']==index['original_observation_sha256'];assert p['stage_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(stage_raw).hexdigest();p['archive_reconstruction']={'screen_index_sha256':hashlib.sha256(screen.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'row_files':files,'stage_storage_sha256':hashlib.sha256(stage.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'exact_screen_bytes_reconstructed':True,'exact_pretty_stage_bytes_reconstructed':True,'script_source':Path(__file__).read_text()};proof.write_text(json.dumps(p,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'family_files':5,'screen_rows':len(rows),'maximum_file_bytes':max(x.stat().st_size for x in [screen,stage,proof,*[folder/i['path'] for i in files]])}))
